criteria.name: Classification Accuracy
criteria.description: The assigned issue category correctly represents the customer's main problem.

criteria.name: Urgency Assessment
criteria.description: The urgency level is appropriate based on the customer's situation.

criteria.name: Reasoning Quality
criteria.description: The explanation clearly supports the selected issue category.

criteria.name: Information Handling
criteria.description: The model correctly handles insufficient or ambiguous information without making unsupported assumptions.

criteria.name: Format Compliance
criteria.description: The output follows the required JSON structure and uses valid classification labels.
